newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RFM Q1 net seen at 220 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: RFM Q1 net seen at 220 mln pesos.

text.p: Diversified food company RFM Corp made net income of about 220 million pesos in the first quarter of 1997, RFM president Jose Concepcion said during a stockholders' meeting on Thursday.
For the first quarter of 1996, RFM posted net income of 97.1 million pesos. For full year 1996, the company reported net income of 503 million pesos.
Additionally, RFM said it is declaring a cash dividend of 0.028 peso a share for shareholders of record on April 18, 1997.
RFM expects to earn 880 million pesos in profits this year, Concepcion reiterated.
The total cash payout on the dividends will amount to 39.19 million pesos, the company said. In 1996, the company paid a cash dividend of 0.025 peso per share.
Concepcion said RFM was boosted by the strong showing in the first quarter of some of its units in the areas of softdrinks, ice cream, milk, juices and bakery products.
Earlier, its softdrinks arm Cosmos Bottling Corp reported it made a net profit of 101 million pesos in the first quarter, 146 percent higher than 41 million pesos in the same period last year.
RFM also said it had acquired a 20-year franchise to operate Little Caesar's, the second largest chain of pizza stores in the United States. Concepcion did not disclose the terms.
In the same meeting, stockholders approved an increase in the company's authorised capital stock to 4.3 billion pesos from 4.09 billion pesos.
The capital stock boost was to accommodate the conversion into common shares of 1.2 billion pesos worth of preferred shares RFM issued to the public.
